task.title: Resolve PM2 Redundancy and Service Loops
task.description: PM2 services 'openclaw-gateway' and 'whisper' were stopped as they were in high-restart loops due to port/process conflicts. Systemd and other gateway services are likely redundant.
task.sourceContext: PM2 list showed hundreds of restarts; logs confirmed port 18789 is already in use by PID 3491996.
keyPoints: PM2 ID 42 (openclaw-gateway) and ID 25 (whisper) are now STOPPED.
A healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running under PID 3491996.
Recommendation: Remove these services from PM2 to prevent further loops.
Recommendation: Clean up redundant systemd gateway services (openclaw-gateway, clawdbot-gateway).
